verses: A Ma῾alot Poem of David. I was glad when they said to me, Let us go into the house of the Lord:
when our feet stood within thy gates, O Yerushalayim;
O Yerushalayim, built as a city that is compact together:
there the tribes used to go up, the tribes of the Lord, an appointed practice for Yisra᾽el, to give thanks to the name of the Lord.
For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
Pray for the peace of Yerushalayim: they who love thee shall prosper:
peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
For the sake of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.
